Amer Sports is a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Atomic and Peak Performance, united by a shared purpose of elevating the world through sport. Our brands are known for their detailed craftsmanship, unwavering authenticity, premium market positioning and compelling market shares in their categories. We pride ourselves on cutting-edge innovation, technical performance and ground-breaking designs that allow athletes and everyday consumers to perform better every day. Through partnerships with industry influencers and elite athletes, and in collaboration with the various communities we serve, we develop next-generation products that define winning moments in sports. Our brands are creators of exceptional apparel, footwear, equipment, protective gear and accessories that we believe give our consumers the confidence and comfort to excel.

Our brands are our stars, constantly elevating the consumer experience and creating thriving communities. We empower our brands to pursue market-shaping leadership and set the standard for quality, performance and brand experience globally. While our brands have established heritage and market leadership today, significant runway remains ahead. We are excited about our future and the opportunity to drive growth in each of our three reportable segments: Technical Apparel, Outdoor Performance and Ball & Racquet Sports. Our segments comprise our "brand clusters," which reflect both how our consumers engage with our products and how we manage our business.

Each segment is led by one of our core brands: Arc'teryx, Salomon and Wilson. Each of these brands creates high-quality technical products that stand out in their respective categories, and possesses key differentiated attributes.

Arc'teryx is a technical outdoor apparel brand inspired by the Canadian Coast Mountains and built on the principle of obsessive, precise design and production. Arc'teryx gear pushes the boundaries of performance and enables adventurers to excel in their outdoor pursuits in the mountains, in the backcountry and on some of the world's most technical climbs. The products are known for their minimalist design, and sleek and streamlined aesthetic, along with new, innovative features that continually advance outdoor activities. Product quality, from the materials to the design, allows Arc'teryx to command premium pricing as evidenced by its best-selling "hardshell" jacket in North America, the Alpha SV. Overall, Arc'teryx combines beautiful, innovative products and an authentic brand experience that extends beyond apparel, fostering communities and bringing people together across all regions of the world who share a passion for the outdoors.

Born in the French Alps in 1947, Salomon creates premium innovative footwear, apparel, winter sports equipment and accessories. Since its founding, Salomon has been fueled by a culture of design, craftsmanship, continuous innovation, and performance inspired by progress, the mountains and athletes. The brand first produced metal ski edges and expanded into releasable ski bindings before launching industry changing rear-entry ski boots and monocoque skis. The brand's leadership in winter sports helped to propel it into a diverse portfolio of sports and products including footwear and apparel. Today, Salomon is a market leader in global trail and gravel running footwear and premium hiking footwear, with products recognized for their performance, style, durability and sustainability. Nearly 70% of Salomon's revenue in 2025 came from footwear, while also having leading market positions in its legacy winter sports equipment categories (skis, snowboards, boots, bindings, goggles, helmets, etc.), creating a 365-day, year-round brand serving all seasons for mountain sport consumers.

Founded in 1914 in Chicago, Illinois, Wilson Sporting Goods is a leading manufacturer of high-performance sports equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories. The Wilson Sporting Goods portfolio is made up of the iconic Wilson brand, as well as Louisville Slugger, DeMarini, EvoShield and ATEC. Collectively, these brands bring more than three centuries of innovation, history and heritage to a variety of mainstream sports. As a multi-sports platform, Wilson drives innovation and product excellence by leveraging learnings across the brands' various disciplines, including tennis, football, baseball and basketball, among other sports. The Wilson brand has a legacy as the top-of-the-line sports equipment and is associated with legendary athletes, including Roger Federer and Caitlin Clark. In addition, Wilson is the official partner of professional sports leagues, including the NBA, WNBA, NFL, the US Open, Roland-Garros, and more. These athletes and leagues are a testament to the credibility and reputation of Wilson's track record of innovation and superior products.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
Our business depends on the strength of our brands, and if we are not able to maintain and enhance our brands, our reputation and results of operations may be adversely affected.
Changes in market trends and consumer preferences could adversely affect our financial results.
Our products, services and experiences face intense competition.
Failure to continue to obtain or retain high-quality brand partners and ambassadors of our products could harm our business.
Harm to our reputation could adversely impact our ability to attract and retain consumers and wholesale partners, employees, brand ambassadors, partners, and other stakeholders.
We rely on technical innovation and high-quality products to compete in the market for our products.
Economic uncertainty in our key markets may affect consumer purchases of discretionary items, which may adversely affect demand for our products.
Inflationary pressures have and may continue to hamper our business.
Our financial success may be impacted by the strength of our relationships with our wholesale partners.
We may be adversely affected by the financial health of our wholesale partners and consumers.
Our growth strategy involves the continued expansion of our DTC channel, including our owned retail stores and e-commerce platforms, which may present risks and challenges.
Our revenues depend in part on the success of our retail stores, including related to volume of traffic to our stores and the availability of suitable lease space.
We face risks associated with the acquisition and divestiture of businesses.
Certain of our brands' products carry warranties, which may result in an increase to our expenses in the event of warranty claims.
Our international operations involve inherent risks which could result in harm to our business.
We face risks associated with our business in the PRC.
Risks Related to Our Distribution Network and Suppliers

Our business or our results of operations could be harmed if we or our wholesale partners are unable to accurately forecast demand for our products or if we are unsuccessful at managing product manufacturing decisions.

We also believe that our platform enables efficient integration, scaling and optimization of target opportunities that fit within our portfolio, as well as critical insight to inform divestiture decisions.

We govern our brands through management across the finance, supply chain, sustainability, communication, legal and compliance functions, among other areas. At the same time, we enable our brands through our group's incubator model that provides shared learnings from data analytics across the platform as well as from the economies of scale and synergies of shared resources, including supplier services, distribution and logistics, human resources and enterprise IT infrastructure. We further serve our brands through access to shared, centralized business services, including customer service and treasury management functions. All together, these resources empower our brand leadership teams to focus on serving consumers through brand, product and go-to-market strategies that drive performance, and our global and scaled operating model enables larger, robust brand organizations to independently flourish.

All around the globe, our brands are united in putting consumers first, meeting them exactly where they shop, across digital and physical spaces. We generate revenue from the sale of our products through direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels:

•Direct-to-Consumer includes sales of our brands' products through (i) owned e-commerce websites and (ii) owned retail stores, which include elevated brand stores that drive consumer engagement and factory outlet stores which serve as a liquidation channel. The DTC channel accounted for 48.9% of our revenue in 2025 and 43.7% of our revenue in 2024.

•Wholesale includes sales of our brands' products through general sporting goods retailers, specialty stores, independently-operated partner stores, distributors, retailer-owned and third-party e-commerce websites as well as revenue from certain licensing arrangements. The wholesale channel accounted for 51.1% of our revenue in 2025 and 56.3% of our revenue in 2024.

Amer Sports 是一個全球知名的運動與戶外品牌集團，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Atomic 和 Peak Performance 等品牌，這些品牌共同承載著透過運動提升世界的使命。我們的品牌以細膩工藝、堅定真實性、高階市場定位與強勢市場佔有率聞名。我們以先進創新、技術性能與突破性設計為傲，使運動員與日常消費者能持續提升表現。透過與產業影響力人物與頂級運動員的合作，並與我們服務的各個社羣協作，我們開發出定義運動勝利時刻的下一代產品。我們的品牌是卓越服飾、鞋類、器材、防護裝備與配件的製造者，我們相信這些產品能讓消費者擁有信心與舒適感，以實現卓越表現。
Courtney Dauwalter 穿著 Salomon 鞋類、服飾與揹包，在 Lavaredo 120km 跑道賽中奪得冠軍。Marta Kostyuk 穿著 Wilson 套裝出賽，參與2025年美國公開賽。
專業登山導覽與攀巖者 Will Gadd 在加拿大班夫國家公園攀爬時信任他的 Arc'teryx 裝備。 Mikaela Shiffrin 在2025年奪得她第106場世界盃賽事冠軍，創下歷史上最多高山世界盃勝利紀錄。
我們的品牌是我們的明星，持續提升消費者體驗並創造蓬勃發展的社羣。我們賦予品牌追求市場領導地位的權力，並在全球範圍內設定品質、性能與品牌體驗的標準。雖然我們的品牌目前已建立深厚歷史與市場領導地位，但仍有長遠發展空間。我們對未來感到興奮，並期待在三個應報告分部：技術服飾、戶外運動與球與網球運動中推動成長。這些分部構成我們的「品牌集羣」，反映消費者如何與我們的產品互動，以及我們如何管理業務。
每個分部均由我們的核心品牌之一領導：Arc'teryx、Salomon 和 Wilson。這些品牌各自製造高品質的技術產品，在其類別中脫穎而出，並具備關鍵差異化特徵。
活動：登山、健行、攀巖、滑雪、單板滑雪、山地跑步、越野跑步、公路跑步、健行、單板滑雪、高山滑雪、北歐滑雪 雪地運動、網球運動、棒球、軟式棒球、足球、籃球、排球、高爾夫球

Arc'teryx 是一個受加拿大海岸山脈啟發的技術性戶外服裝品牌，建立在對設計與製造的極致精準原則之上。Arc'teryx 的產品不斷突破性能極限，讓冒險者能在山區、荒野及世界最技術性的攀爬中表現卓越。產品以極簡設計、流線美學，以及持續創新功能聞名，這些功能不斷提升戶外活動的表現。從材料到設計的產品品質，使 Arc'teryx 能夠訂出高價位，例如在北美最暢銷的「硬殼」外套 Alpha SV。總體而言，Arc'teryx 結合了美觀、創新產品與真實的品牌體驗，超越服裝本身，建立社羣，將熱愛戶外活動的人們連結起來，跨越全球各地。

Salomon 於 1947 年在法國阿爾卑斯山成立，製造高階創新鞋類、服裝、冬季運動裝備與配件。自創立以來，Salomon 一直以設計、工藝、持續創新與表現為文化動力，靈感來自進步、山區與運動員。該品牌最初製造金屬滑雪鋁邊，後擴展至可釋放式滑雪綁帶，並推出改變產業的後入式滑雪靴與單體滑雪板。品牌在冬季運動領域的領導地位，使其拓展至多樣化的運動與產品，包括鞋類與服裝。目前，Salomon 是全球山地與越野跑步鞋類與高階健行鞋類的市場領導者，產品以性能、風格、耐用性與永續性聞名。2025 年，Salomon 約 70% 的營收來自鞋類，同時在傳統冬季運動裝備類別（滑雪板、單板滑雪、靴子、綁帶、護目鏡、頭盔等）也擁有領導地位，創造全年無休的品牌，服務所有季節的山區運動消費者。

Wilson Sporting Goods 於 1914 年在美國伊利諾州芝加哥成立，是高階運動器材、服裝、鞋類與配件的領導製造商。Wilson Sporting Goods 的產品組合包括標誌性的 Wilson 品牌，以及 Louisville Slugger、DeMarini、EvoShield 和 ATEC。這些品牌 collectively 帶來超過三個世紀的創新、歷史與傳統，服務多種主流運動。作為多項運動平台，Wilson 透過各品牌不同領域的知識，推動創新與產品卓越，包括網球、足球、棒球與籃球等運動。Wilson 品牌有著頂級運動器材的聲譽，與傳奇運動員如 Roger Federer 和 Caitlin Clark 有關聯。此外，Wilson 是多個職業運動聯盟的官方合作夥伴，包括 NBA、WNBA、NFL、美國網球公開賽、羅蘭·加洛斯等。這些運動員與聯盟證明瞭 Wilson 在創新與卓越產品方面的聲譽與紀錄。

Amer Sports 是一個全球知名的運動與戶外品牌羣，包括 Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Atomic 和 Peak Performance。我們的品牌以其細緻工藝、堅定真實性、高階市場定位及在各自類別中具競爭力的市場佔有率而聞名。我們以尖端創新、技術性能及突破性設計為傲，使運動員與日常消費者能持續提升表現。透過與產業影響者及頂級運動員的合作，並與我們服務的各個社羣協作，我們開發下一代產品，定義運動中的勝利時刻。我們的品牌是創造卓越服飾、鞋類、器材、防護裝備及配件的創作者，我們相信這些產品能讓消費者擁有信心與舒適感，持續表現出色。

我們的品牌是我們的明星，持續提升消費者體驗，並創造蓬勃發展的社羣。我們賦予品牌追求市場領導地位的權力，並在全球範圍內設定品質、性能與品牌體驗的標準。雖然我們的品牌目前已建立歷史與市場領導地位，但仍有相當大的成長空間。我們對未來感到興奮，並期待在我們三個應報告分部：技術服飾、戶外運動與球類與運動器材中推動成長。這些分部即為我們的「品牌羣組」，反映消費者如何與我們的產品互動，以及我們如何管理業務。每個分部由我們的核心品牌之一領導：Arc'teryx、Salomon 和 Wilson。

Arc'teryx 是一個受加拿大海岸山脈靈感啟發的技術戶外服飾品牌，建立在對設計與生產的執著與精準原則之上。Arc'teryx 的產品推動性能極限，使冒險者能在山區、荒野及世界最技術性的攀爬中表現卓越。產品以其極簡設計、流線美學，以及持續創新功能而聞名，不斷提升戶外活動。產品品質，從材料到設計，使 Arc'teryx 能夠訂定高價位，如其在北美最暢銷的「硬殼」外套 Alpha SV。總體而言，Arc'teryx 結合優美、創新產品與真實的品牌體驗，超越服飾，促進社羣，並將熱愛戶外活動的人們連結在一起。

Salomon 於 1947 年在法國阿爾卑斯山成立，創造高階創新鞋類、服飾、冬季運動器材及配件。自成立以來，Salomon 一直以設計、工藝、持續創新與由進步、戶外與運動員啟發的性能文化為動力。該品牌最初生產金屬滑雪邊刃，並拓展至可釋放式滑雪綁帶，之後推出改變產業的後入式滑雪靴與單體滑雪板。該品牌的冬季運動領導地位使其拓展至多樣化的運動與產品，包括鞋類與服飾。今日，Salomon 是全球越野跑鞋與高階徒步鞋的市場領導者，其產品以性能、風格、耐用性與可持續性而聞名。2025 年 Salomon 約 70% 的營收來自鞋類，同時在傳統冬季運動器材類別（滑雪板、滑雪板、靴子、綁帶、眼鏡、頭盔等）擁有領導市場地位，創造一個全年無休、服務所有季節的運動消費者品牌。

Wilson Sporting Goods 於 1914 年在美國伊利諾州芝加哥成立，是高階運動器材、服飾、鞋類及配件的領導製造商。Wilson Sporting Goods 的產品組合包括標誌性的 Wilson 品牌，以及 Louisville Slugger、DeMarini、EvoShield 和 ATEC。這些品牌共同帶來超過三個世紀的創新、歷史與傳統，服務多種主流運動。作為一個多運動平台，Wilson 透過跨品牌各個領域的知識（包括網球、棒球與籃球等運動）推動創新與產品卓越。Wilson 品牌有著作為頂級運動器材的歷史，與傳奇運動員如 Roger Federer 和 Caitlin Clark 有關聯。此外，Wilson 是多個職業運動聯盟的官方合作夥伴，包括 NBA、WNBA、NFL、美國網球公開賽、羅蘭加洛斯等。這些運動員與聯盟證明瞭 Wilson 在創新與卓越產品方面的聲譽與紀錄。

雖然 Arc'teryx、Salomon 和 Wilson 在我們三個分部中處於領導地位，但我們的其他品牌也恰當地符合我們的運動導向產品組合。Peak Performance 提升我們在運動類別中的規模、競爭地位與多元化。Atomic 和 Armada 讓我們在全球冬季運動器材領域處於領導地位。我們的棒球品牌，包括 Louisville Slugger、DeMarini、EvoShield 和 ATEC，在各自類別中為市場領導者。總體而言，我們的品牌使我們能在各個運動領域中領導與競爭，並推動我們產品組合的持續成功。

我們擅長於識別、開發與定義符合我們企業願景的品牌。我們賦予這些品牌自主連接消費者並開發產品以推動成長的能力。我們的平台透過擴充的基礎設施與財務控管措施來支持這些品牌，以加速表現。我們相信，我們平台的規模與多元化可降低風險，並提供財務彈性，以謹慎投資，以符合消費者持續演進的需求，開發競爭優勢，並透過對創新無所不用其極的關注，推動各品牌成長。我們也相信，我們的平台能有效整合、擴充與優化符合我們投資組合的目標機會，以及提供關鍵見解，以協助做出出售決策。

我們透過財務、供應鏈、永續性、溝通、法律與合規等管理功能，來治理我們的品牌，同時，我們也透過集團的育成模式來支持我們的品牌，該模式提供來自平台數據分析的共用學習成果，以及來自共用資源的規模經濟與協同效益，包括供應商服務、分銷與物流、人力資源與企業資訊科技基礎設施。我們進一步透過對共用、集中式商業服務的存取，來服務我們的品牌，包括客戶服務與財務管理功能。所有這些資源，使我們的品牌領導團隊能專注於透過品牌、產品與市場進入策略來服務消費者，並透過我們全球規模化的運營模式，使較大的、強韌的品牌組織能獨立茁壯。
在全球各地，我們的品牌都秉持以消費者為先的原則，並在他們購物的數位與實體空間中，精準地與消費者接觸。我們透過直接對消費者與批發渠道銷售產品來產生收入：
•直接對消費者包括透過（i）自有電商網站與（ii）自有零售商店銷售我們品牌產品，這些零售商店包括提升品牌形象的商店，以促進消費者參與，以及廠庫直銷商店，作為清算渠道。直接對消費者渠道在2025年佔我們營業收入的48.9%，在2024年佔我們營業收入的43.7%。
•批發包括透過一般運動用品零售商、專門店、獨立經營的合作夥伴商店、經銷商、零售商自營與第三方電商網站銷售我們品牌產品，以及來自某些授權安排的收入。批發渠道在2025年佔我們營業收入的51.1%，在2024年佔我們營業收入的56.3%。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們的業務依賴品牌強度，若無法維持並提升品牌，將可能對我們的聲譽及營運結果產生負面影響。
市場趨勢與消費者偏好變動可能對我們的財務結果產生負面影響。
我們的產品、服務與體驗面臨強烈競爭。
若無法持續取得或留住高品質的品牌合作夥伴與產品大使，將可能損害我們的業務。
聲譽受損可能對我們吸引並留住消費者與經銷商、員工、品牌大使、合作夥伴及其他利害關係人產生負面影響。
我們依賴技術創新與高品質產品在產品市場中競爭。
本公司主要市場之經濟不確定性可能影響消費者對非必要商品之購買，可能不利於本公司產品之需求。
通貨膨脹壓力已影響並可能持續影響本公司業務。
本公司財務表現可能受本公司與經銷商之關係強弱影響。
本公司可能因經銷商之財務狀況及消費者之財務狀況而受到不利影響。
本公司成長策略包含持續擴展直營通路，包括本公司自有零售門市及電商平台，此可能帶來風險與挑戰。
本公司收入部分取決於零售門市之表現，包括人流量及合適租賃空間之可得性。
本公司面臨與企業併購及出售相關之風險。
部分本公司品牌之產品提供保固，若發生保固聲請，可能導致本公司費用增加。
本公司之國際業務涉及內在風險，可能導致對本公司業務造成損害。
本公司在中國大陸地區之業務面臨相關風險。
與本公司通路網路及供應商相關之風險
若本公司或本公司經銷夥伴無法準確預測產品需求，或本公司無法有效管理產品製造決策，將可能對本公司業務或營運成果造成損害。
